video_title: J.R. Smith joins The Richard Show | NBA Finals 10-Year Reunion

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on the pressure of playing in a classroom setting
quotes.excerpt: I get so nervous and like my palms sweat.
quotes.quote: I get so nervous and like my palms sweat. Money ball, jump shot, I got it. I am letting it go, but in that setting, I struggle a lot.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and J.R. Smith on the 2016 NBA Finals comeback
quotes.excerpt: helped Cleveland finish the most famous 3-1 comeback in finals that we have ever seen.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: One ring came as he helped Cleveland finish the most famous 3-1 comeback in finals that we have ever seen.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on the difficulty of retiring from the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I didn't want to retire. I didn't want to stop playing.
quotes.quote: I didn't want to retire. I didn't want to stop playing. You chose to when you stop playing.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on how he got the nickname Swish
quotes.excerpt: I got Swish by Chucky Atkins when I was playing with him in Denver.
quotes.quote: I got Swish by Chucky Atkins when I was playing with him in Denver. I had a spree of two or three games. I had like nine, 11 and like seven threes in a row. Every shot was hitting, it was going straight through the net. It wasn't hitting no rim. He was like, man, this motherfucker not even hitting the rim. He was like, man, he's Swish. That's his name now, Swish.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith ranks his favorite versions of LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I'm cutting 2020 Bron, I'm starting 2016 Bron and I'm benching 2018 Bron.
quotes.quote: I'm cutting 2020 Bron, I'm starting 2016 Bron and I'm benching 2018 Bron.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on his mentality when shooting contested threes
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I turn my brain off and I just react.
quotes.quote: I feel like I turn my brain off and I just react. I think that helps me more. When I get it and I'm like, oh, okay, I got to turn my brain off.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on the impact of joining the Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: It felt amazing because they really didn't know what they were getting.
quotes.quote: It felt amazing because they really didn't know what they were getting. And when I showed up, they had a completely different perspective of who I was. It was kind of fun because I watched people literally like flip their whole perspective of who I was. That's one thing I love about Cleveland because they gave me the opportunity to just prove to them who I was instead of just taking everybody else's word for it.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on playing better at home in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I always played better at home, especially in the playoffs.
quotes.quote: I always played better at home, especially in the playoffs. I just feed off the crowd more and I think it's like the routine and the rhythm of what we are so accustomed to.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on the impact of LeBron James and Tyronn Lue
quotes.excerpt: I've never played with two teammates who almost believed in me more than I believed in myself.
quotes.quote: I've never played with two teammates who almost believed in me more than I believed in myself. Essentially what Tyronn Lue was telling LeBron James like, bro, you not going to shoot what you going to shoot? I think I only shot like one shot in the first half. And he was like, what are you going to do? You going to shoot? Like, this is game seven. We need you. You need to. I'm like, all right.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on his defensive decision in Game 1 of the 2018 NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I knew I couldn't just cut him off. I had to make him change the ball.
quotes.quote: I knew I couldn't just cut him off. I had to make him change the ball because if he changes the ball, that'll give LeBron James enough time. But if he just goes up and like straight arm, lay it up and then touches the glass quick, then it'll be goaltending. So that's why I kind of swiped, but I was trying not to foul him. I was just literally trying to make it seem like, so I could give LeBron James an extra second.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on the sacrifice required to win a championship
quotes.excerpt: I think people don't realize how much the Cavaliers sacrificed.
quotes.quote: I think people don't realize how much the Cavaliers sacrificed. And I think in order to obviously win a championship, you have to have that consistently over a course of a year. The Cavaliers sacrificed more than any high-profile player going into a team like that and winning a championship.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on Kevin Love's role on the 2016 Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: I think Kevin Love was one of the better or higher three-point percentage players on the team.
quotes.quote: And I think you, I mean correct me if I'm wrong, he was one of the better or higher three-point percentage players on the team.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on overcoming his academic struggles
quotes.excerpt: I grew up in a different situation with my academics.
quotes.quote: I grew up in a different situation with my academics. Growing up in special ed and fighting all these demons growing up. I mean to me, that's just as good as a six man, if not better.

quotes.speaker: J.R. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: J.R. Smith on the lack of accountability in basketball compared to golf
quotes.excerpt: To me, I think why did I spend all of this money on this stuff that I don't use?
quotes.quote: To me, I think why did I spend all of this money on this stuff that I don't use? But not only that, I don't really care about. I had seven cars at one point and we were in Cleveland. I'm like, why did I have seven cars?
